$comment: The fields a hand correction may change, and what each accepts. Read by pipeline/corrections.py (noh correct, noh apply-corrections), the admin screen (web/src/lib/admin) and the Corrections form. One definition, so they cannot drift. `tones` is also pipeline/vespers.py's TONES. min_letters: at least that many letters (a title of "1" is never right). arabic_to_roman: 1-8 is saved as I-VIII. not_for_genres: pieces of these genres have no such value, with the reason.

title.hint: plain text with at least two letters, no < or >

incipit.hint: plain text with at least two letters, no < or >

mode.hint: I to VIII (1 to 8 is read as I to VIII)

not_for_genres.proper: A Proper has no single mode: each of its parts (Introit, Gradual…) has its own.

genre.hint: a lower-case genre such as proper or kyrie

system_range.hint: its first and last system, e.g. noh1/0044/002-noh1/0046/003 (every image on the site carries its ref); a system taken from the piece before or after leaves that piece

start_system.hint: the system of the piece the part starts on, counting from 1

chant.hint: a GregoBase chant id (the number in gregobase.selapa.net/chant.php?id=…), or none

tone.hint: a tone as NOH8 prints it, e.g. VIII.G, IV.A* or peregrinus

chant.hint: a GregoBase chant id (the number in gregobase.selapa.net/chant.php?id=…), or none

refs.hint: the systems it is printed on, in order, separated by spaces, e.g. noh8/0077/000 noh8/0077/001 (every image on the site carries its ref)

note.hint: a sentence shown in place of the music (plain text, no < or >), or none to show the music again

chant.hint: a GregoBase chant id (the number in gregobase.selapa.net/chant.php?id=…), or none

sections.hint: the piece's whole list of sections in the order the book prints them, as JSON: each {kind, n?, variant?, label?, title?, system (counting from 1) or ref, or borrowed_volume and borrowed_page, chant}; it replaces the list the piece has now

match.hint: the part it is (part:<slug>/<part>[:<variant>], movement:<slug>/<movement> or piece:<slug>), none if it is not in the catalogue, or other-setting if it is another setting of a chant the catalogue has

reader_fields.$comment: The Corrections form's field names (workers/corrections/src/schema.ts) as fields of a piece; chant pairings are fixed at the source, not by correction.
reader_fields.title: title

targets_help.part: part:<slug>/<part>, or part:<slug>/<part>:<variant> (introit, gradual, alleluia, tract, sequence, offertory, communion)
targets_help.vespers: vespers:<office>/antiphon-<n> or vespers:<office>/magnificat (an office of data/vespers/vespers-offices.yml); vespers:sunday:<calendar key>/magnificat (a green Sunday's Magnificat antiphon, data/vespers/vespers-noh8.yml)
targets_help.pairing: pairing:<slug>/<movement>: the chant paired with one movement of a piece without Proper parts (kyrie, gloria, credo, sanctus, agnus, ite; chant for a single-chant piece)
targets_help.sections: sections:<slug>: a Proper's whole list of sections (introit, gradual, hymn, alleluia, tract, sequence, offertory, communion, other), for sections only
targets_help.review: review:<volume>/<kind>/<id>: an item of data/review-queue.json (its `key`), for `reviewed` only
targets_help.typeset: typeset:<file>: a transcription in data/typeset/src/ (its path there, e.g. vol-1/al_crastina_die.csv.ly), for match or reviewed

pairing_movements.$comment: The chant movements each genre of piece has ("chant": the one chant of a single-chant piece). A Proper's chants are on its parts.

reviews.$comment: `reviewed` records that an editor looked at a target and found it right; it changes no data. Its `was` is what was confirmed: a review-queue item's fingerprint, a part's start and length, or a typeset file's render hash (so an edit to the file reopens its proofreading). When that changes the review lapses (the item comes back) instead of stopping the build.

typeset_file.$comment: A typeset:<file> target's file: a path under data/typeset/src/, never with .. or a leading /.
